BORA ÖNAL

Game Programmer & Sound Designer

I'm a final-year student in the Cartoon and Animation department at Yaşar University, working on the game development side of the field. In Unity I program the core mechanics and the systems underneath them, and I code the UI/UX that players touch. In FL Studio I make the sound effects and music that complete a game's atmosphere.

I regularly join game jams with my teammates, shipping playable games under tight deadlines. I strengthen my programming with independent software courses and certifications, and I follow current industry practice through Gamescom's student programs, technical sessions and developer meetups.

UNDER THE HOOD

How this page is built:

  • Three.js scene rendered at reduced resolution and upscaled with nearest-neighbour filtering for the pixel look.
  • Fire and embers: a custom GPU particle shader; point size is derived from world units so it holds at any resolution.
  • Character picking: raycasts against invisible hitboxes on a separate render layer (press ~ on the campfire screen for the engine debug overlay, then tick "Hitboxes").
  • Static batching: every piece of scenery that never moves is merged into one mesh per material, so the whole environment costs a handful of draw calls instead of hundreds. The grass is a single instanced mesh.
  • Atmosphere: a gradient sky dome, unfogged horizon silhouettes, scrolling ground-mist layers and vertex-painted ground.
  • Selection outline: OutlinePass post-processing.
  • Camera: a small state machine (title → intro → idle → zooming → panel → returning) driven by GSAP timelines.
  • Adaptive quality: render resolution and particle density drop automatically when the frame rate stays low.
